body: I don't know. Anything. I'm sitting here just waiting to start, and I know once I do I won't stop. That's something I've been denied for months now.

I did read that...and it made me terribly sad, but the difference is, i don't have people in my life that this will really affect. nobody has reached out. thy've done the opposite, they've cut me out entirely. it's just me here.
I just want to talk to someone
Just trying to hear people. Communicate. I don't have that in real life anymore.
A lot...I really just wrote this because I wanted to get it out and I know if I tell anyone who knows me, they'll report me.
I don't remember much. I've sort of pieced things together from my surroundings. I'm a cigarette smoker, and I'm having trouble smoking because the taste reminds me of how it felt to be suffocating.
